a.speaker: narrator
a.text: A med station hums quietly. Its auto-doc can patch Kai up and run repairs on BOLT, but a full treatment cycle takes time.

bolt.speaker: bolt
bolt.text: Diagnostics complete! All my bits are where they should be. Your bits too, probably.

solo.speaker: narrator
solo.text: The auto-doc beeps cheerfully. Kai feels almost human again.

sealed.speaker: narrator
sealed.text: The breach is sealed tight. BOLT's welds are ugly, but they hold.

a.speaker: bolt
a.text: Ruptured seal. Good air goes out, bad air comes in. I can weld a patch over it, but it's fiddly work.

b.speaker: bolt
b.text: Sealed! Breathe deep, Kai. That's the good stuff. Well. The less bad stuff.

hello.speaker: vendor
hello.name: Vend-O-Matic
hello.text: WELCOME, VALUED RESIDENT! Our apologies for the apocalypse. All prices unchanged!

menu.speaker: vendor
menu.name: Vend-O-Matic
menu.text: Balance: {scrap} scrap. What can I get you?

bye.speaker: vendor
bye.name: Vend-O-Matic
bye.text: THANK YOU FOR SHOPPING! Please enjoy your continued survival!

b.speaker: voss
b.name: Captain Voss
b.text: Carefully, B-0LT. Whatever is inside that case is older than our whole species.

c.speaker: bolt
c.name: B-0LT-7 (memory)
c.text: Handling fragile cargo, Captain. I have a 99.2% no-drop rating. The 0.8% was not my fault.

d.speaker: narrator
d.text: The case is warm against BOLT's manipulators. Something inside pulses. Light. Dark. Light.

f.speaker: bolt
f.text: ...Huh. That was the Captain. Why was I carrying something for the Captain? I fix air ducts. Mostly.

g.speaker: kai
g.text: There might be more of your memory files scattered around the ship. Keep your sensors open.

b.speaker: halcyon
b.text: Captain, the object is transmitting. Light pulses at prime-numbered intervals. It is deliberate.

c.speaker: dray
c.name: Chief Dray
c.text: It's a derelict with a blinking light. We don't stop a colony ship for a blinking light.

d.speaker: voss
d.name: Captain Voss
d.text: Prime numbers don't happen by accident, Marcus. Someone wanted to be found.

e.speaker: okafor
e.name: Dr. Okafor
e.text: Captain, the hull is organic. It isn't a ship. It's a seed. Or a lifeboat.

f.speaker: voss
f.name: Captain Voss
f.text: Bring it aboard. Full quarantine protocols. B-0LT-7, you're on retrieval.

g.speaker: bolt
g.text: I remember the airlock. It was so cold out there. And the Seed... the Seed was warm.

b.speaker: okafor
b.name: Dr. Okafor
b.text: The shell is opening. Look at it. It's glowing.

c.speaker: narrator
c.text: Inside the Seed, a small knot of luminous tendrils unfurls. It pulses: blue. Blue. Gold.

d.speaker: okafor
d.name: Dr. Okafor
d.text: B-0LT, blink your work light at it. Same rhythm. Blue, blue, gold.

e.speaker: bolt
e.name: B-0LT-7 (memory)
e.text: I don't have gold, Doctor. I have 'warm white.' ...Okay. Trying.

f.speaker: narrator
f.text: BOLT blinks. The Seed answers instantly, brighter and faster, in a cascade of color.

g.speaker: okafor
g.name: Dr. Okafor
g.text: Oh... oh, it's talking. It's saying hello.

h.speaker: bolt
h.text: I talked to it, Kai. I was the first one who ever talked to it.

b.speaker: dray
b.name: Chief Dray
b.text: It's growing, Elena. It's in the air ducts. That's not a guest. That's an invasion.

c.speaker: voss
c.name: Captain Voss
c.text: It's a refugee. Its world is gone. Amara decoded enough to know that much. It is the last of its kind.

d.speaker: dray
d.name: Chief Dray
d.text: And if it decides the Leviathan is its new world?

e.speaker: voss
e.name: Captain Voss
e.text: Then we talk to it. That's what we do. We don't burn the only other life we've ever met.

g.speaker: narrator
g.text: Dray leaves. BOLT, powered down in the corner, records the look on his face.

h.speaker: bolt
h.text: He didn't understand, Kai. He'd already decided.

b.speaker: dray
b.name: Chief Dray
b.text: Incinerator teams, go. Burn it down to the stem.

c.speaker: okafor
c.name: Dr. Okafor
c.text: Marcus, NO! It's frightened, look at the colors, it's...

d.speaker: narrator
d.text: BOLT moves between the flamethrowers and the Seed. It doesn't know why. It just does.

e.speaker: bolt
e.name: B-0LT-7 (memory)
e.text: Please stop. It's saying 'please.' It's saying please, it's saying please, it's...

f.speaker: narrator
f.text: Fire. White noise. The Bloom screams in light, every color at once, and then the lab goes dark.

g.speaker: bolt
g.text: ...That's why I'm afraid of the dark, Kai. It was the last thing I saw before I woke up in that closet.

i.speaker: bolt
i.text: And it's been protecting itself ever since. Everything it's done... it's scared.

b.speaker: voss
b.name: Captain Voss
b.text: If anyone finds this: the Bloom is not attacking us. It's afraid, and hurt, and it's surviving the only way it knows. By growing.

c.speaker: voss
c.name: Captain Voss
c.text: Amara's notes are gone. But the drone, B-0LT-7, spoke to it first. The pattern is in its memory. Light is how it speaks.

d.speaker: voss
d.name: Captain Voss
d.text: Find the drone. Tell the Bloom we're sorry. Tell it there's still room for both of us.

e.speaker: bolt
e.text: Kai... I remember the pattern. Blue, blue, gold: 'hello.' White, blue: 'safe.' Gold, gold, gold: 'together.'

all.speaker: bolt
all.text: Every memory file is restored. I know the whole language now. If we get close to the Heart, I can talk to it. I know I can.

some.speaker: bolt
some.text: But there are gaps. Missing files. Without them, the words come out wrong. I'd need every memory to really talk to it.
